To: All Hiring Managers
From: Sandra Okafor, Director of Talent Acquisition
Date: November 8
Subject: Streamlined Reference-Check Procedure

Dear Hiring Managers,

Over the past six months, our average time-to-hire for mid-level corporate roles has crept up from 28 days to 39 days. A recent internal review revealed that nearly a week of that delay occurs during the manual reference-check phase, when recruiters and managers struggle to coordinate phone calls with a candidate's former supervisors.

Effective Monday, November 14, Human Resources will transition to an automated digital reference-checking platform, VerifyPro. Under this new workflow, once a finalist is selected, the assigned recruiter will trigger an secure questionnaire link to the candidate's designated references. Responses are typically returned within 48 hours and automatically compiled into a summary report in our Applicant Tracking System (ATS).

Please note that managers should no longer contact professional references directly by phone unless specifically advised to do so by HR for executive-level appointments. Thank you for helping us deliver a faster, more consistent experience to our prospective hires.

Meridian Financial Consolidates Regional Operations in Downtown Hub
By Clara Jensen, Business Desk

Meridian Financial Group announced yesterday that it will consolidate three suburban administrative offices into a newly leased, 45,000-square-foot workspace in the downtown financial district early next year. The move affects approximately 260 employees across payroll processing, compliance, and customer account administration.

Chief Operating Officer Arthur Pendelton stated that the consolidation is designed to eliminate redundant facility leases and foster closer collaboration among support teams that previously operated across separate municipalities. "Bringing our administrative specialists under one roof will shorten internal approval cycles and reduce annual real estate overhead by an estimated 18 percent," Pendelton explained during a press briefing.

To ease the transition for affected staff, Meridian will introduce a commuter transit subsidy of $150 per month and expand its flexible hybrid schedule, allowing eligible employees to work remotely up to two days per week. No layoffs are planned as part of the restructuring.

m01_173.text:
Why Structured Onboarding Matters More Than Ever in Hybrid Workplaces

A recent survey of 400 mid-sized corporations conducted by the Workplace Strategy Institute found that organizations with formal, 90-day onboarding programs retain 58 percent more new hires past their first anniversary than those relying on informal, ad-hoc training. The gap is particularly pronounced in hybrid environments, where new employees spend fewer hours observing colleagues in person.

"When a new hire works remotely three days a week, casual hallway conversations disappear," notes Dr. Evelyn Torres, lead author of the study. "Without intentional touchpoints—such as scheduled peer-buddy check-ins and clear 30-60-90-day milestones—junior staff often feel isolated and struggle to grasp unwritten office norms."

Forward-thinking HR departments are responding by pairing every newcomer with a cross-departmental mentor and standardizing digital welcome kits that outline communication etiquette, escalation channels, and key stakeholder directories before day one.

考點：值班部門（同義替換）。
• 關鍵解析：語音指出緊急建築進出或廠商送貨可按 2 轉接 Facilities Security team，同義替換為 (D) Building Protection。
• 誘答陷阱：(A) 關聯 job application；(C) 挪用 vendor delivery；(B) 挪用 administrative。

questions.q: What milestone did the company achieve last quarter?
options: Eliminating physical billing across its local branches
Cutting 400 hours from regional travel-claim processing
Updating corporate travel reimbursement guidelines across all divisions
Completing an internal audit of Finance's manual data entry

explain.text:
考點：季度里程碑（同義替換）。
• 關鍵解析：講者宣布達成 100 percent paperless invoicing across all domestic divisions，同義替換為 (A) Eliminating physical billing across its local branches。
• 誘答陷阱：(B) 挪用 400 hours、regional；(C) 挪用 corporate travel reimbursement guidelines、divisions；(D) 挪用 internal audit、Finance、manual data entry。

questions.q: What challenge does the speaker mention regarding the regional offices?
options: Finance has been flagging domestic claims by mistake.
Receipts are taking over 400 hours to reach headquarters.
Staff are not uniformly following expense-reporting rules.
Several branches are still using manual data entry for invoicing.

explain.text:
考點：區域辦公室問題（同義替換）。
• 關鍵解析：講者指出 inconsistent adherence to our corporate travel reimbursement guidelines，同義替換為 (C) Staff are not uniformly following expense-reporting rules。
• 誘答陷阱：(D) 挪用 several branches、manual data entry、invoicing；(A) 挪用 Finance、flags、domestic；(B) 挪用 receipts、400 hours。

questions.q: What action will be taken next month to address this challenge?
options: Hosting a training session on paperless invoicing guidelines
Requiring Finance to manually inspect all unitemized receipts
Restricting travel reimbursement claims at regional branches
Deploying a digital tool that screens submissions for errors

explain.text:
考點：改善措施（同義替換）。
• 關鍵解析：講者宣布下個月將 implement automated expense-auditing software that flags missing details，同義替換為 (D) Deploying a digital tool that screens submissions for errors。
• 誘答陷阱：(B) 挪用 Finance、manual、unitemized receipts；(C) 挪用 travel reimbursement、regional；(A) 挪用 paperless invoicing、guidelines。

questions.q: What change is taking effect next Monday?
options: Meetings longer than fifteen minutes will require calendar approval.
Staff must tap their employee badges to enter headquarters.
Updated reservation procedures will apply to meeting spaces.
Tablets will be installed outside conference rooms on Floors 4 through 8.

explain.text:
考點：政策變動（同義替換）。
• 關鍵解析：講者宣布 a new booking rule will take effect for all shared conference rooms，同義替換為 (C) Updated reservation procedures will apply to meeting spaces。
• 誘答陷阱：(D) 挪用 tablet、Floors 4 through 8（平板原本就存在）；(B) 挪用 tap your employee badge、headquarters；(A) 挪用 fifteen minutes、calendar。

questions.q: What happens if a reserved room is not occupied within fifteen minutes?
options: Other teams must wait until the next scheduled calendar slot.
The tablet outside the door sends a reminder to headquarters staff.
The reservation is released for other groups to use.
The meeting organizer's employee badge is temporarily deactivated.

explain.text:
考點：違規後果（同義替換）。
• 關鍵解析：獨白說明若 15 分鐘內未報到，the booking will be automatically canceled... freeing up the space for other teams，同義替換為 (C) The reservation is released for other groups to use。
• 誘答陷阱：(A) 挪用 other teams、calendar；(D) 挪用 employee badge；(B) 挪用 tablet outside the door、headquarters staff。

questions.q: Why does the speaker say, "We've all walked past empty rooms that looked booked on the calendar"?
options: To apologize for recent glitches in the room-booking system
To explain the rationale behind the upcoming policy
To remind staff to check the calendar before walking to Floors 4 through 8
To encourage teams to cancel meetings fifteen minutes in advance

explain.text:
考點：修辭意圖（同義替換）。
• 關鍵解析：講者反問「我們都曾走過行事曆上顯示已預訂卻空無一人的會議室」，緊接著說明這是為了讓空間更公平，對應 (B) To explain the rationale behind the upcoming policy。
• 誘答陷阱：(C) 挪用 calendar、Floors 4 through 8；(A) 挪用 room、booked；(D) 挪用 canceled、fifteen minutes。

questions.q: What service is being advertised?
options: Offering 24-hour reception coverage for small agencies
Conducting year-end payroll audits for busy offices
Training administrative assistants to manage open enrollment
Providing short-term office personnel during high-demand periods

explain.text:
考點：廣告服務內容（同義替換）。
• 關鍵解析：廣告主打 temporary staffing for peak business seasons，同義替換為 (D) Providing short-term office personnel during high-demand periods。
• 誘答陷阱：(B) 挪用 year-end audits、payroll；(C) 挪用 administrative assistants、open enrollment；(A) 挪用 24、reception、agencies。

questions.q: According to the speaker, what distinguishes Apex Workforce from its competitors?
options: It handles unexpected staff leaves without charging consultation fees.
It swaps out mismatched hires within two days for free.
It pre-vets all payroll clerks in as little as 24 hours.
It guarantees permanent placements before this Friday.

explain.text:
考點：競爭優勢（同義替換）。
• 關鍵解析：講者強調不同於其他機構，他們提供 48-hour candidate replacement guarantee at no extra charge，同義替換為 (B) It swaps out mismatched hires within two days for free。
• 誘答陷阱：(C) 挪用 pre-vetted、payroll clerks、24 hours；(A) 挪用 unexpected staff leaves、consultation；(D) 挪用 placement、Friday。

questions.q: How can listeners receive a complimentary consultation?
options: By visiting an Apex Workforce branch during peak hours
By signing up before the next open enrollment period
By requesting a pre-vetted placement within 48 hours
By telephoning the company prior to the weekend

explain.text:
考點：行動呼籲（同義替換）。
• 關鍵解析：講者呼籲 Call 1-800-555-0194 before this Friday，同義替換為 (D) By telephoning the company prior to the weekend。
• 誘答陷阱：(B) 挪用 open enrollment；(C) 挪用 pre-vetted、placement、48-hour；(A) 挪用 Apex Workforce、peak。

questions.q: What topic is the speaker currently explaining?
options: Annual salary bonuses for full-time employees
Industry certifications offered by the HR department
Financial assistance for work-related continuing education
Internal workshops required during new-hire orientation

explain.text:
考點：演講主題（同義替換）。
• 關鍵解析：講者介紹 professional development tuition reimbursement program，同義替換為 (C) Financial assistance for work-related continuing education。
• 誘答陷阱：(A) 挪用 full-time employees；(D) 挪用 workshops、new-hire orientation；(B) 挪用 industry certifications、HR。

questions.q: What must employees do before submitting a formal request?
options: Get signed permission from their immediate manager
Pay the $3,000 course fee to an accredited institution
Register for a university course aligned with HR's goals
Complete an industry certification listed on the HR Intranet

explain.text:
考點：申請前置步驟（同義替換）。
• 關鍵解析：講者規定申請前必須 obtain written approval from your direct supervisor，同義替換為 (A) Get signed permission from their immediate manager。
• 誘答陷阱：(B) 挪用 $3,000、accredited institution；(D) 挪用 industry certification、HR Intranet；(C) 挪用 register、university course、goals。

questions.q: What does the speaker advise listeners to check on the intranet?
options: The calendar year deadline for tuition reimbursement
Instructions for writing a career-goal statement
A directory of eligible educational providers
A list of workshops that cost under $3,000

explain.text:
考點：內部網站查詢內容（同義替換）。
• 關鍵解析：講者建議上內網查看 list of pre-approved accredited institutions，同義替換為 (C) A directory of eligible educational providers。
• 誘答陷阱：(A) 挪用 calendar year、tuition reimbursement；(B) 挪用 career goals；(D) 挪用 workshops、$3,000。

questions.q: Look at the graphic. Which stage experienced a delay due to slow grading by managers?
options: Phone Screening
Applications Received
Final Panel Interview
Technical Assessment

explain.text:
考點：圖表交叉比對題（數據線索 + 階段對應）。
• 關鍵解析：獨白中刻意不唸出階段名稱，僅提示「在 40 位候選人的階段出現瓶頸，因為部門主管批改個案作業太慢」。對照招募漏斗表格中 Number of Candidates = 40 的階段，即為 (D) Technical Assessment。
• 誘答陷阱：(B)、(A)、(C) 皆為表格中其他階段名稱，必須聽懂「40 candidates」並對照表格才能正確選出。

questions.q: According to the speaker, what caused the delay at that stage?
options: Supervisors took too long to evaluate candidates' work.
Half of the 40 candidates requested extra time for the workload.
Recruiters took 20 days to schedule the final panel interview.
Only 25 percent of applicants submitted their case assignments on time.

explain.text:
考點：延遲原因（同義替換）。
• 關鍵解析：講者說明延誤主因是 department managers were slow to grade the submitted case assignments，同義替換為 (A) Supervisors took too long to evaluate candidates' work。
• 誘答陷阱：(D) 挪用 25 percent、case assignments；(B) 挪用 half、40、workload；(C) 挪用 20、final panel interview。

questions.q: How many candidates ultimately received job offers based on the funnel?

explain.text:
考點：數據計算題。
• 關鍵解析：最終關卡有 20 位決選者，轉換率為 25%，20 × 25% = 5 位獲得錄取。

questions.q: Look at the graphic. Which item requires immediate attention according to the speaker?

explain.text:
考點：圖表交叉比對題（庫存數量對應品號）。
• 關鍵解析：獨白刻意不唸出品號或狀態標籤，僅提示「目前庫存僅剩兩件（only two units remaining in stock）的品項需要立即關注」。對照庫存表 Current Stock = 2 的品項，即為 (B) OS-219（Black Toner Cartridge）。
• 誘答陷阱：(A)、(C)、(D) 皆為表格中其他品項代碼，若只看圖表不知道「needs immediate attention」對應哪一列，必須聽懂數量線索交叉比對。

questions.q: Why does the speaker mention that a major supplier is relocating its warehouse?
options: To announce that Friday's shipment has been canceled
To explain why several items dipped below the reorder threshold
To ask staff to switch to a local office supply vendor
To account for an anticipated delivery delay

explain.text:
考點：說話意圖（同義替換）。
• 關鍵解析：講者提到供應商本週搬遷區域倉庫是為了說明 shipping times will be longer than usual，同義替換為 (D) To account for an anticipated delivery delay。
• 誘答陷阱：(A) 挪用 Friday、shipment（週五會到貨，非取消）；(B) 挪用 dipped below、reorder threshold；(C) 挪用 office supply vendor。

questions.q: What does the speaker ask employees to do until Friday?
options: Wait until Friday morning to submit office supply orders
Conserve ink and paper when producing hard copies
Stop all printing jobs until the shipment arrives within 24 hours
Check the supply closet for remaining units in stock

explain.text:
考點：呼籲配合事項（同義替換）。
• 關鍵解析：講者請大家 print double-sided documents in black and white whenever possible and avoid unnecessary color print jobs，同義替換為 (B) Conserve ink and paper when producing hard copies。
• 誘答陷阱：(C) 挪用 print jobs、shipment、24 hours；(D) 挪用 units、stock；(A) 挪用 Friday morning、office supply。

questions.q: Had the human resources director _______ the revised compensation package earlier, several senior engineers might not have accepted competing offers.
options: approve
approving
approved
been approved

explain.text:
考點：與過去事實相反的假設語氣倒裝（Had + S + p.p.）。
• 關鍵解析：主句為 might not have accepted（過去完成式假設），從句省略 If 並將 Had 移至句首形成倒裝：Had the HR director approved...，故選過去分詞 approved。
• 錯誤選項：(A) 原形、(B) 現在分詞皆無法與 Had 構成過去完成式；(D) 被動語態與受詞 the revised compensation package 衝突。
• 高階單字：compensation package (薪酬福利方案)。

questions.q: All reimbursement claims must be submitted _______ ten business days of the completion of any corporate travel.
options: among
within
during
across

explain.text:
考點：時間介系詞辨析（within vs. during / among / across）。
• 關鍵解析：表示「在……期限之內」搭配具體時間長度（ten business days）須用 within。
• 錯誤選項：(C) during 後接特定事件或期間名稱（如 during the conference）；(A) among 用於三者以上之間；(D) across 用於空間跨越或遍及。
• 高階單字：reimbursement claim (費用報銷申請)。

questions.q: The new onboarding software _______ administrative errors by nearly 40 percent since it was introduced last quarter.
options: has reduced
reduces
will reduce
was reducing

explain.text:
考點：動詞時態（現在完成式搭配 since 子句）。
• 關鍵解析：句尾有時間副詞子句 since it was introduced last quarter（自從上季引進以來），表示動作從過去持續至今，主要子句須使用現在完成式，故選 (A) has reduced。
• 錯誤選項：(B) 現在簡單式表達常態事實；(D) 過去進行式表達過去某時間點正在進行；(C) 未來式與 since 過去時間起點不符。
• 高階單字：administrative error (行政疏失)、onboarding (n. 新人報到/入職引導)。

questions.q: Ms. Henderson requested that every department head _______ a preliminary headcount forecast before Friday's executive committee meeting.
options: will submit
submit
submitted
submits

explain.text:
考點：要求/建議類動詞後的假設語氣（that + S + (should) + V）。
• 關鍵解析：動詞 requested 後的 that 名詞子句須使用原形動詞（省略 should），即使主詞 every department head 為第三人稱單數，仍須選原形 submit。
• 錯誤選項：(D) 第三人稱單數現在式、(C) 過去式、(A) 未來式皆違反建議類動詞的虛擬語氣規則。
• 高階單字：headcount forecast (員額/人力預測)。

questions.q: _______ the unexpected resignation of the chief operating officer, the board of directors convened an emergency session to appoint an interim successor.
options: Provided that
Even though
As soon as
In light of

explain.text:
考點：介系詞片語 vs. 連接詞辨析。
• 關鍵解析：空格後方為名詞片語 the unexpected resignation of the chief operating officer，須填入介系詞片語 (D) In light of（鑑於、考量到）。
• 錯誤選項：(B) Even though、(A) Provided that、(C) As soon as 皆為從屬連接詞，後方須接完整主詞與動詞的子句。
• 高階單字：convene (v. 召開)、interim successor (臨時接任者)。

questions.q: The facilities team is currently evaluating three commercial cleaning contractors, _______ has extensive experience servicing multi-tenant office towers.
options: every one of whom
each of whom
each of which
each of them

explain.text:
考點：非限定關係代名詞（先行詞為事物）。
• 關鍵解析：逗號後方無對等連接詞，故須使用關係代名詞連接兩個子句；先行詞為 three commercial cleaning contractors（商業清潔承包商，此處指「公司/廠商機構」且後方用單數動詞 has），在商業英文中機構常視為事物，故選 each of which。
• 錯誤選項：(D) each of them 缺乏連接詞功能，會造成逗號拼接（comma splice）錯誤；(B) whom 與 (A) every one of whom 專指「人」（且此處 contractors 指公司）。
• 高階單字：multi-tenant (adj. 多租戶的)。

questions.q: _______ thoroughly by the legal compliance unit, the updated employee handbook will be distributed digitally to all regional branches next Monday.
options: To review
Reviewing
Having reviewed
Having been reviewed

explain.text:
考點：分詞構句（完成被動式 Having been + p.p.）。
• 關鍵解析：逗號後主詞為 the updated employee handbook（手冊），與動詞 review 之間為「被審閱」關係，且審閱動作發生在「下週一發放」之前，故用完成被動分詞構句 (D) Having been reviewed。
• 錯誤選項：(B)、(C) 皆為主動語態；(A) 不定詞表示「目的」，與 by the legal compliance unit 語意不合。
• 高階單字：legal compliance (法規遵循)。

questions.q: Because the quarterly town hall will be broadcast live to overseas subsidiaries, presenters are advised to speak clearly and avoid _______ industry jargon.
options: exceedingly
exceeded
excessive
exceed

explain.text:
考點：詞性辨析（形容詞修飾名詞）。
• 關鍵解析：空格位於及物動詞 avoid 之後、名詞片語 industry jargon 之前，須填入形容詞修飾 jargon，故選 (C) excessive（過多的）。
• 錯誤選項：(B) exceeded 為過去分詞，「被超過的行話」語意不通；(A) exceedingly 為副詞；(D) exceed 為動詞。
• 高階單字：industry jargon (產業行話/專業術語)。

questions.q: Confidential personnel files must remain in the secured human resources archive unless employees obtain written _______ from a department director.
options: authorizing
authorize
authorization
authorized

explain.text:
考點：詞性辨析（形容詞後接名詞受詞）。
• 關鍵解析：及物動詞 obtain 後方有形容詞 written（書面的），須填入名詞作為受詞，故選 (C) authorization（授權、核准）。
• 錯誤選項：(B) 動詞原形；(D) 過去分詞／形容詞；(A) 現在分詞／動名詞，皆不可置於形容詞 written 之後充當核心受詞。
• 高階單字：authorization (n. 授權、批准)、archive (n. 檔案庫)。

questions.q: While the pilot telecommuting program yielded higher employee morale, productivity metrics remained _______ unchanged compared with the previous quarter.
options: virtually
vitally
visibly
vividly

explain.text:
考點：副詞語意辨析（virtually unchanged）。
• 關鍵解析：句意為「雖然遠距試辦計畫提升了員工士氣，但生產力指標與前一季相比『幾乎』維持不變」，virtually（幾乎、實質上）為固定高頻搭配。
• 錯誤選項：(C) visibly（明顯地）、(D) vividly（生動地）、(B) vitally（極其重要地）皆不符語意。
• 高階單字：virtually (adv. 幾乎、實質上)、morale (n. 士氣)。

questions.q: Candidates applying for the bilingual executive assistant position must demonstrate _______ in both written correspondence and simultaneous note-taking.
options: proficiently
proficiency
proficient
proficiencies

explain.text:
考點：詞性辨析（動詞後接不可數名詞受詞）。
• 關鍵解析：動詞 demonstrate 缺少受詞，須填入名詞 proficiency（精通、熟練度），且 proficiency 為不可數名詞。
• 錯誤選項：(C) 形容詞；(A) 副詞；(D) 複數形態一般不用於此搭配 demonstrate proficiency in。
• 高階單字：simultaneous (adj. 同步的、即時的)。

questions.q: _______ the vendor delivers the ergonomic chairs by Wednesday afternoon, the facilities crew will not be able to finish furnishing the seventh floor before the new hires arrive.
options: Whether
Except
Unless
Otherwise

explain.text:
考點：條件連接詞辨析（Unless = If... not）。
• 關鍵解析：句意為「『除非』供應商在週三下午前送達人體工學椅，否則設施團隊將無法在新進人員抵達前完成七樓布置」，故選條件連接詞 (C) Unless。
• 錯誤選項：(A) Whether（是否）；(D) Otherwise（否則，為副詞而非連接詞）；(B) Except（除了……之外，後不接完整子句）。
• 高階單字：furnish (v. 布置家具/配備設施)。

questions.q: The procurement manager insisted on _______ multiple bids from certified suppliers before awarding the annual office stationery contract.
options: solicit
solicited
soliciting
solicitation

explain.text:
考點：介系詞後接動名詞（insist on + V-ing）。
• 關鍵解析：片語 insist on 中的 on 為介系詞，後方又有受詞 multiple bids，故須填入動名詞 (C) soliciting（徵求、招標）。
• 錯誤選項：(A)、(B) 不可置於介系詞後；(D) 名詞 solicitation 後方不能直接接受詞 multiple bids。
• 高階單字：solicit bids (招標/徵求報價)。

questions.q: Employees wishing to enroll in the company-sponsored leadership seminar should register promptly, as seating is _______ limited to twenty-five participants.
options: tightly
strictly
densely
narrowly

explain.text:
考點：副詞與過去分詞的慣用搭配（strictly limited）。
• 關鍵解析：表示「嚴格限制在二十五名參與者」，標準商務搭配為 strictly limited to。
• 錯誤選項：(D) narrowly（勉強地/狹窄地）、(A) tightly（緊密地）、(C) densely（密集地）皆不與 limited 構成此慣用搭配。
• 高階單字：promptly (adv. 迅速地、準時地)。

questions.q: The newly appointed vice president of operations has a proven track record of _______ underperforming regional offices into profitable business units.
options: transforming
transmitting
transacting
transferring

explain.text:
考點：動詞與介系詞 into 的語意搭配（transform A into B）。
• 關鍵解析：句意為「將表現不佳的區域辦公室『轉型』為獲利的業務單位」，固定搭配 transform... into...。
• 錯誤選項：(D) transfer（調動/轉帳）；(B) transmit（傳輸/傳送訊號）；(C) transact（辦理交易）。
• 高階單字：track record (過往實績/紀錄)。

questions.q: _______ she had only been with the firm for eight months, Priya Nair was entrusted with leading the cross-functional task force on workplace automation.
options: Despite
Albeit
Whereas
Although

explain.text:
考點：讓步連接詞辨析（Although + 子句）。
• 關鍵解析：空格後方為完整子句 she had only been with the firm for eight months，且前後語意對比（雖僅任職八個月，卻被委以重任），故選 (D) Although。
• 錯誤選項：(A) Despite 為介系詞；(B) Albeit 後接名詞、形容詞或介系詞片語，不接完整子句；(C) Whereas 表「對比（然而）」，多置於兩對等子句之間而非句首帶出個人經歷讓步。
• 高階單字：entrust A with B (將 B 託付給 A)。

questions.q: Should any technical discrepancies _______ during the transition to the new payroll system, please notify the support team immediately.
options: arise
arose
arising
arisen

explain.text:
考點：未來條件句的 Should 倒裝（Should + S + 原形 V）。
• 關鍵解析：If any technical discrepancies should arise... 省略 If 並將 Should 移至句首，助動詞 Should 後方動詞須用原形，故選 (A) arise。
• 錯誤選項：(B) 過去式、(D) 過去分詞、(C) 現在分詞皆不可接在 Should 之後。
• 高階單字：discrepancy (n. 差異、不符之處)、transition (n. 系統轉換)。

questions.q: The internal audit revealed several _______ between the travel expense receipts submitted by the sales division and the corporate credit card statements.
options: inconsistencies
inclinations
interruptions
interventions

explain.text:
考點：商務名詞語意辨析。
• 關鍵解析：句意為「內部稽核揭露了差旅收據與公司信用卡帳單之間的多處『不一致』」，對應 (A) inconsistencies。
• 錯誤選項：(C) interruptions（中斷）；(D) interventions（干預）；(B) inclinations（傾向）。
• 高階單字：inconsistency (n. 不一致/矛盾處)。

questions.q: To ensure uninterrupted reception coverage during lunch hours, administrative assistants are asked to _______ their break times with a colleague at the front desk.
options: conform
collaborate
comply
coordinate

explain.text:
考點：動詞語意與介系詞搭配（coordinate A with B）。
• 關鍵解析：句意為「行政助理被要求與櫃檯同事『協調』彼此的午休時間」，coordinate... with... 為標準用法。
• 錯誤選項：(B) collaborate 為不及物動詞，後方不直接接受詞 their break times；(C) comply 須接 with；(A) conform 須接 to。
• 高階單字：uninterrupted (adj. 不間斷的)。

questions.q: The executive board unanimously agreed that the proposed restructuring plan is _______ with the organization's long-term sustainability objectives.
options: competitive
competent
compatible
comparable

explain.text:
考點：形容詞與介系詞 with 的搭配（be compatible with）。
• 關鍵解析：句意為「提案的重組計畫與組織的長期永續目標『相容/一致』」，選 (C) compatible（與……相容/一致）。
• 錯誤選項：(D) comparable（可比較的，常接 to）；(A) competitive（具競爭力的）；(B) competent（有能力的）。
• 高階單字：unanimously (adv. 一致地)、compatible with (與……相容/符合)。

questions.q: _______ the heavy rain delayed several commuters this morning, the mandatory compliance briefing began promptly at 9:00 A.M. as scheduled.
options: Although
Even so
As though
In spite

explain.text:
考點：讓步連接詞 / 介系詞結構辨析。
• 關鍵解析：空格後是完整子句 the heavy rain delayed several commuters this morning，須填從屬連接詞；前後語意相反（大雨延誤通勤，簡報仍準時開始），故選讓步連接詞 (A) Although。
• 錯誤選項：(D) 缺少 of；(B) 副詞不可連接子句；(C) 語意不符。
• 高階單字：as scheduled (按照原定時間)。

questions.q: Mr. Takahashi's meticulous attention to detail and calm demeanor under pressure make him _______ suited for the role of corporate crisis coordinator.
options: excepted
exceptionally
exception
exceptional

explain.text:
考點：副詞修飾過去分詞形容詞（exceptionally suited）。
• 關鍵解析：動詞 make + 受詞 (him) + 受詞補語 (suited)，空格用於修飾形容詞化分詞 suited，須填入副詞 (B) exceptionally（極其、異常地）。
• 錯誤選項：(C) 名詞；(D) 形容詞；(A) 介系詞/動詞。
• 高階單字：meticulous (adj. 一絲不苟的)、demeanor (n. 舉止、風度)。

questions.q: Before signing the commercial lease renewal, the operations director asked external counsel to _______ every clause regarding early termination penalties.
options: stabilize
scrutinize
subsidize
speculate

explain.text:
考點：商務高階動詞辨析（scrutinize）。
• 關鍵解析：句意為「在簽署商業租約續約前，營運總監請外部法律顧問『仔細審查』每一條關於提前解約罰則的條款」，選 (B) scrutinize（細查、嚴格檢視）。
• 錯誤選項：(D) speculate（推測/投機）；(A) stabilize（穩定）；(C) subsidize（補助）。
• 高階單字：scrutinize (v. 仔細審查)、early termination penalty (提前解約罰款)。

questions.q: The annual performance appraisal form has been redesigned _______ managers can provide more actionable, competency-based feedback to their direct reports.
options: as to
such as
in order to
so that

explain.text:
考點：目的連接詞辨析（so that + 子句）。
• 關鍵解析：空格後方為完整子句 managers can provide...，表示目的「以便讓主管能提供……」，須用連接詞 (D) so that。
• 錯誤選項：(C) in order to 與 (A) as to 後接原形動詞或名詞；(B) such as 用於舉例。
• 高階單字：competency-based (adj. 基於職能的)、direct report (直屬部屬)。

questions.q: _______ of the two shortlisted applicants possesses the exact combination of accounting certification and labor law knowledge required for the position.
options: Both
None
All
Neither

explain.text:
考點：不定代名詞與單複數動詞一致（Neither of + 複數名詞 + 單數動詞）。
• 關鍵解析：關鍵線索為 the two shortlisted applicants（兩者）以及單數動詞 possesses。指兩者中「皆不」且搭配單數動詞，須選 (D) Neither。
• 錯誤選項：(A) Both 須搭配複數動詞 possess；(B) None 與 (C) All 用於三者或以上。
• 高階單字：shortlisted (adj. 入圍的)。

questions.q: Over the past decade, Meridian Logistics has _______ its administrative headquarters three times to accommodate rapid workforce expansion.
options: allocated
relocated
dislocated
collocated

explain.text:
考點：同字根動詞辨析（relocate vs. allocate / dislocate / collocate）。
• 關鍵解析：句意為「過去十年間，Meridian 物流已將其行政總部『搬遷』了三次以因應人力擴張」，選 (B) relocated。
• 錯誤選項：(A) allocated（分配/撥款）；(C) dislocated（使脫臼/使混亂）；(D) collocated（並置/共同配置）。
• 高階單字：accommodate (v. 容納、配合)。

questions.q: Any visitor entering the research and development wing must be _______ by an authorized staff member at all times.
options: accumulated
accomplished
accommodated
accompanied

explain.text:
考點：被動語態與動詞語意辨析（be accompanied by）。
• 關鍵解析：句意為「任何進入研發區的訪客必須隨時由授權員工『陪同』」，選 (D) accompanied。
• 錯誤選項：(B) accomplished（完成）；(C) accommodated（容納/提供住宿）；(A) accumulated（累積）。
• 高階單字：authorized (adj. 經授權的)。

questions.q: The HR committee postponed its decision on the tuition-assistance policy _______ it could gather benchmark data from peer companies in the industry.
options: by
until
during
since

explain.text:
考點：時間連接詞辨析（until）。
• 關鍵解析：句意為「人資委員會延後對學費補助政策的決定，『直到』它能收集到同業的基準數據」，選 (B) until。
• 錯誤選項：(D) since（自從/因為）時態與語意不合；(C) during 為介系詞；(A) by 為介系詞。
• 高階單字：benchmark data (基準數據/標竿資料)。

questions.q: _______ to popular belief, implementing a four-day compressed workweek did not reduce total client support hours at the regional call center.
options: Adverse
Reverse
Contrary
Opposite

explain.text:
考點：固定介系詞片語（Contrary to）。
• 關鍵解析：固定片語 Contrary to popular belief 意為「與普遍認知相反」。
• 錯誤選項：(D) Opposite、 (A) Adverse、(B) Reverse` 皆無此固定句首搭配。
• 高階單字：compressed workweek (濃縮工時週，如週休三日但每日工時拉長)。

questions.q: All confidential paper records marked for disposal must be placed in locked security bins rather than standard recycling receptacles, _______ failure to do so constitutes a policy violation.
options: as
yet
nor
or

explain.text:
考點：對等/從屬連接詞語意辨析（as 表「因為」）。
• 關鍵解析：逗號後方為完整子句解釋原因：「『因為』未這麼做將構成違反政策」，as 在正式商務寫作中常作「因為」解，引導原因子句，選 (A)。
• 錯誤選項：(B) yet（然而）、(C) nor（也不）、(D) or（否則，邏輯相反：應該是「不放進去『否則』違規」，但後方主詞已是 failure to do so「未這樣做」）。
• 高階單字：constitute (v. 構成)、receptacle (n. 容器/垃圾桶)。

questions.q: Choose the best answer for blank (131).
options: Meanwhile
Instead
Consequently
Moreover

explain.text:
考點：轉折副詞辨析。
• 關鍵解析：前句說「工作站將不再永久分配給個別員工」，後句說「員工將改用 DeskFlow 應用程式提前預約座位」，兩者為「取而代之」的替代關係，故選 (B) Instead。
• 錯誤選項：(C) 因此、(D) 此外、(A) 同時皆不如 Instead 精準。

questions.q: Choose the best answer for blank (132).
options: Several conference rooms on Floor 4 are currently closed for painting.
Employees who work remotely five days a week are exempt from this policy.
To facilitate this change, all desks on both floors have been standardized.
The renovation budget was approved by the board last spring.

explain.text:
考點：句子插入題（承先啟後）。
• 關鍵解析：本段後方緊接著描述「每個工作站都配備了通用桌面擴充座、雙螢幕和可調式人體工學椅，確保無論坐哪裡都能無縫銜接」，正是在說明為何「兩層樓的所有辦公桌都已標準化」，故選 (C)。
• 錯誤選項：(D) 談預算、(B) 談純遠距員工、(A) 談四樓油漆皆與該段主題無關。

questions.q: Choose the best answer for blank (133).
options: Otherwise
Therefore
Nonetheless
In contrast

explain.text:
考點：因果轉折詞辨析。
• 關鍵解析：前句說「我們理解適應共享座位環境需要時間」，後句說「設施團隊下週將舉辦三場導覽說明會」，為明顯的因果關係，選 (B) Therefore。
• 錯誤選項：(C) 儘管如此、(A) 否則、(D) 相較之下皆不合邏輯。

questions.q: Choose the best answer for blank (134).
options: designating
designate
designation
designated

explain.text:
考點：連綴動詞 remain 後接過去分詞當形容詞補語。
• 關鍵解析：部門協作區將維持「被指定/保留給需要並肩作業團隊使用」的狀態，remain + designated (for...)，選 (D)。
• 錯誤選項：(B) 原形、(A) 主動分詞、(C) 名詞皆不符語法。

questions.q: Choose the best answer for blank (135).
options: The Chicago office is conveniently located two blocks from Union Station.
Previous candidates who applied for this role need not resubmit their resumes.
Quarterly town halls are held in the main auditorium on the first floor.
You will also partner closely with Finance to model cost savings across key initiatives.

explain.text:
考點：句子插入題（職責補充）。
• 關鍵解析：第一段介紹 Senior Operations Analyst 的核心職責，(D)「你還將與財務部密切合作，為各項關鍵計畫建立成本節省模型」自然延續職責說明，並使用 also 銜接前句。
• 錯誤選項：(B) 談過去應徵者、(A) 談交通位置、(C) 談員工大會皆與該段職責介紹不連貫。

questions.q: Choose the best answer for blank (136).
options: collaboration
collaborative
collaborate
collaborated

explain.text:
考點：助動詞 will 後接原形動詞。
• 關鍵解析：空格前為 will frequently，後方須接原形動詞與 with division heads 搭配，故選 (C) collaborate。
• 錯誤選項：(B) 形容詞、(A) 名詞、(D) 過去式皆不合語法。

questions.q: Choose the best answer for blank (137).
options: For instance
As a result
On the contrary
In addition

explain.text:
考點：遞進轉折詞辨析。
• 關鍵解析：前句列出薪資、健保、特休等福利，後句補充每年提供 2,500 美元專業進修津貼，屬於福利的進一步補充，選 (D) In addition。
• 錯誤選項：(C) 相反地、(A) 例如（津貼並非前句福利的舉例）、(B) 結果皆不合。

questions.q: Choose the best answer for blank (138).
options: via
among
upon
onto

explain.text:
考點：介系詞辨析（透過某管道/平台）。
• 關鍵解析：表示「透過線上徵才入口網站」提交履歷，須用介系詞 (A) via。
• 錯誤選項：(D) onto（到……表面上）、(B) among（在……之中）、(C) upon（在……之上/一經……）皆不符。

questions.q: Choose the best answer for blank (139).
options: Several employees requested a transfer to the marketing department last month.
To address this discrepancy, we are introducing a standardized, company-wide framework.
Most managers found the previous software interface intuitive and easy to navigate.
The annual holiday luncheon will take place immediately following the review cycle.

explain.text:
考點：句子插入題（問題與對策銜接）。
• 關鍵解析：前句指出問題「各部門獨立評分偶爾導致全公司標準不一致」，後句說「從今年十二月起，所有總監將參與跨部門校準會議」，(B)「為了解決這項差異，我們正導入標準化、全公司通用的架構」完美承上啟下。
• 錯誤選項：(A) 轉調行銷部、(D) 假日午宴、(C) 舊軟體好用皆不連貫。

questions.q: Choose the best answer for blank (140).
options: are requiring
will require
have required
will be required

explain.text:
考點：未來被動語態（will be required to）。
• 關鍵解析：句意為「在會議召開前，主管們『將被要求』彙整具體、可衡量的成就實例」，表示未來義務的被動語態為 (D) will be required。
• 錯誤選項：(B)、(C)、(A) 皆為主動語態，與主詞 managers 及後方 to compile 搭配錯誤。

questions.q: Choose the best answer for blank (141).
options: Such
Every
Few
Either

explain.text:
考點：指示形容詞指代前文概念（Such + 不可數名詞）。
• 關鍵解析：documentation 為不可數名詞，指代前句所說「具體可衡量的成就紀錄」，用 Such documentation（此類文件紀錄）最為精準，選 (A)。
• 錯誤選項：(B) Every 與 (D) Either 皆接可數單數名詞；(C) Few 接可數複數名詞。

questions.q: Choose the best answer for blank (142).
options: which
whom
where
that

explain.text:
考點：非限定關係副詞（where 指代「在該簡報會議中」）。
• 關鍵解析：逗號後方為完整子句 we will address any questions regarding the revised timeline（不缺主詞也不缺受詞），先行詞為 our mandatory briefing on November 14（視為場合/地點概念），故選關係副詞 (C) where。
• 錯誤選項：(A) which 與 (D) that 須接不完整子句（且 that 不可用於逗號後）；(B) whom 指人。

questions.q: Choose the best answer for blank (143).
options: Although
Once
Because
Unless

explain.text:
考點：讓步連接詞辨析（Although）。
• 關鍵解析：前子句說「所有外部訪客都必須出示有效附照片證件」，後子句說「已預先登記的訪客可以使用快速 QR code 自助機秒印證件」，兩者呈現對比讓步關係，選 (A) Although。
• 錯誤選項：(C) Because（因為）、(D) Unless（除非）、(B) Once（一旦）皆不合前後邏輯。

questions.q: Choose the best answer for blank (144).
options: instead of
regardless of
prior to
according to

explain.text:
考點：介系詞片語辨析（prior to）。
• 關鍵解析：句意為「請在訪客抵達時間『至少兩小時前』於線上訪客入口網站完成登記」，選 (C) prior to（在……之前）。
• 錯誤選項：(A) instead of（代替）；(B) regardless of（不管）；(D) according to（根據）。

questions.q: Choose the best answer for blank (145).
options: Underground parking rates for monthly permit holders will remain unchanged next year.
Guests who have not been pre-registered will need to wait for manual verification by reception staff.
The lobby coffee shop will extend its morning hours to accommodate early commuters.
Lost or damaged employee badges can be replaced at the human resources office for a $15 fee.

explain.text:
考點：句子插入題（未預先登記的後果）。
• 關鍵解析：前句提醒大家提前兩小時預先登記以避免訪客延誤，(B)「未預先登記的訪客將需要等候櫃檯人員進行人工核對」直接補充未配合的後果，與前句緊密相扣。
• 錯誤選項：(C) 咖啡廳、(D) 員工遺失補發、(A) 地下停車費皆偏離該段「訪客預約登記」主題。

questions.q: Choose the best answer for blank (146).
options: compliance
compliant
comply
complying

explain.text:
考點：詞性辨析（形容詞 full 後接名詞）。
• 關鍵解析：動詞 ensure 後接 full _______ with building safety standards，full 為形容詞，後方須填入名詞 (A) compliance（遵守、合規），構成固定搭配 compliance with。
• 錯誤選項：(C) 動詞；(B) 形容詞；(D) 動名詞/現在分詞。

questions.q: What is the purpose of the announcement?
options: To mandate that North Tower employees work from home this weekend
To inform personnel of a brief interruption in building services
To introduce new keycard procedures for Floors 3 through 9
To announce that the underground parking garage will be closed Saturday

explain.text:
考點：主旨題（同義替換）。
• 關鍵解析：公告指出北棟 3 至 9 樓的空調與溫控系統將於週六早上 7 點至下午 5 點因維護而暫停運作，將 air-conditioning、unavailable 替換為 (B) a brief interruption in building services。
• 誘答陷阱：(D) 挪用 underground parking garage（原文說不受影響）；(C) 挪用 keycard、Floors 3 through 9；(A) 挪用 North Tower、work from home（原文僅「強烈鼓勵」而非「強制」）。

questions.q: What is indicated about the South Tower on October 22?
options: Its temperature control will remain unaffected by the work.
Staff will be barred from retrieving personal items there.
Preventative maintenance crews will inspect it at 6:00 P.M.
Its keycard access will be suspended from 7:00 A.M. to 5:00 P.M.

explain.text:

questions.q: How does VerifyPro collect feedback from a candidate's references?

By arranging phone calls with a candidate's former supervisors

When specifically directed to do so for top-tier appointments

questions.q: Why will the welcome packets arrive later than expected?

To move 260 employees from downtown into three suburban offices

questions.q: Who is required to complete the training module?

Both regular staff members and outside contractors
